news.title: Ken Paxton Announces 18 Endorsements from Texas Republican Congressional Delegation
news.description:
Texas Attorney General and U.S. Senate candidate Ken Paxton announced endorsements from 18 members of Texas’s Republican congressional delegation as he campaigns against Democrat James Talarico.
